title: Spectral Algebras of Abelian Cayley Graphs
summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $N$, $S \subseteq G \setminus \{0\}$ a symmetric connection set, and $K$ a field with $char(K) \nmid N$. The spectral algebra $\mathscr{A_K}(Cay(G,S)) = K[A]$ generated by the adjacency matrix of the Cayley graph is proved to decompose, via the character-orbit decomposition, as a semisimple product of field extensions of $K$, one factor for each $Gal(\overline{K}/K)$-orbit of the eigenvalues $λ_χ= \sum_{s \in S} χ(s)$.
